build_yolov3_model: build a YOLOv3 detection model with Darknet53 backbone and COCO dataset for object detection
configure_train_pipeline: configure a training data pipeline with augmentation, random crop, resize, and flip for YOLOv3
setup_dataloader_coco: setup train and validation dataloaders for COCO dataset with aspect ratio batch sampling
configure_optimizer_sgd: configure SGD optimizer with learning rate scheduling and gradient clipping for YOLOv3 training
run_yolov3_training: run YOLOv3 training with 273 epochs, MultiStepLR scheduler, and COCO bounding box evaluation
